title: MAIN KYA BATOU KE KYA KYA GUZAR GAYI AMMA
body:
MAIN KYA BATOU KE KYA KYA GUZAR GAYI AMMA
MAIN SUCHTI HUN KE MAIN KYUN NA MARGAYI AMMA
1.Sunane Ranj O Alam Karbala Se Aayi Hu
Rasool e Pakh Ki Umaat Ki Main Satayi Hu
Nashan e Dagh e Rasan Bazuou Pe Laayi Hu
<<DIVIDER>>
2.Bhara Howa Tha Tera Ghar Jo Subhe Aashora
Ke Ek Din Me Howa Qatl Ghar ka Ghar Saara
Hussain Bhai Ka Be Sar Padha Raha Laasha
<<DIVIDER>>
3.Wo Sham Sham e Ghareeba Daare Howe Bache
Baadhe Jo Julm Ke Saaye Toh Khouf Se Bache
Na Maange Aabo Giza Aur Sogaye Bache
<<DIVIDER>>
4.Main Kya Batou Sakina Pe Kya Sitam Guzre
Tamache Marke Rukhsar Kardiye Neele
Na Rone Paayi Na So Paayi Shimr Ke Dar Se
<<DIVIDER>>
5.Bhula Na Payengi Manzar Wo Zainab e Muztar Ke Ek Nigha Thi Qaime Pe Ek Khanjar Par
Barhena Sar Chali Aaye Na Soch Kar Khahar
<<DIVIDER>>
6.Barhena Sar Sar e Bazar Thi Teri Dukhtar
Nigha e Gair Ke Chubte They Qalb Me Khanjar
Wo Zakhm Aj Bhi Taaza Hai Qalbe Zainab Par
<<DIVIDER>>
7.Wo Asr e Tang Ka Hanggam Gurbat e Sarwar
Raage Gale Ki Na Katti Thi Kund Tha Khanjar
Hussain Paon Raghde The Khakh e Maqtal Par
<<DIVIDER>>
8.Likha Hai Tune Jo Nouha Najaf Ali Shoukat
Mili Hai Mehdi Ko Zikre Hussain Se Izzat
Bayan Kardi Jo Baad e Hussain Thi Gurbat
